user_facing_rule: Only show PMP Current / PMP-CURRENT-1 as the app version.

update_rule: Route Guardian v14 opens the current app only after the user presses Open Latest App. Current v8 keeps the Route Guardian Last Good doorway path and adds a Continuous Run State Ledger with phase, last completed fix, next planned fix, blocked state, cycle state, route guardian fallback, and do-not-repeat fix ledger. This does not begin Packet 1.5, enable autonomous paid execution, authorize merging, prove hook validation, real app proof, current-clean, frozen, or best-in-world.
